THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section Reference No. Ja./2/2/5/5/2024. I, hereby declare under sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose. It is hereby announced that all those who claim titles, rights or any other connections to the above land/ ownership, must appear before me at 10.00 am on the 22nd day of the month of January in 2025 by themselves or by their authorized persons through written documents at the Divisional Secretariat Ja-Ela. Further, information on the nature of their rights regarding the particular land/lands, the requests made for compensation, the compensation claim and the way it was calculated should also be sent to me in two written documents before 15th day of the month of January 2025. P. A. A. S. Weerasekara, Divisional Secretary, Ja-Ela. At the Divisional Secretariat Ja-Ela. On this 02nd day of December, 2024,
